role: The compound tag: a key-to-tag map that every snapshot file, entity NBT, tile entity, item stack tag and world info is built from.
scope_reason: The backbone of snapshot state and the d.ents digest; the native engine cannot load, edit or hash state without it.

members.name: tagMap
members.note: An opaque insertion-ordered compound node; nbtbin.c reproduces the JDK 8 HashMap iteration order (bucket index ascending, insertion order inside a bucket) structurally from the put order.

members.name: write
members.note: Walks the keys in HashMap order; proven byte for byte by the d.ents SHA-1 digest on the replayed mob-free tapes.

members.name: func_152446_a
members.note: Reads tagged entries to the END byte; the 512 depth guard lives in the region reader's depth parameter.

members.name: func_150296_c
members.note: Key iteration; native walks the fields in put order, which is what the binary writer needs.

members.name: getId
members.note: Constant 10; the compound kind of nbt_type.

members.name: setByte
members.note: All the typed setters build a node and nbt_put it.

members.name: setBoolean
members.note: A byte tag of 1 or 0, like Java's setByte.

members.name: getTag
members.note: Null when the key is absent, both sides.

members.name: func_150299_b
members.note: The stored tag's type id, 0 when absent; native is nbt_kind(nbt_get(key)).

members.name: hasKey
members.note: A non-null lookup.

members.name: func_150297_b
members.note: The type-checked hasKey with the 99 any-numeric rule; native readers check the kind inline after the lookup (the crafting code is where the missing-key compound case is spelled out in a comment).

members.name: getByte
members.note: The engine only reads a scalar as the type it was written as, so the ClassCastException fallback and the cross-type coercion never fire.

members.name: getShort
members.note: Same well-typed-data assumption.

members.name: getInteger
members.note: Same well-typed-data assumption.

members.name: getLong
members.note: Same well-typed-data assumption.

members.name: getFloat
members.note: Same well-typed-data assumption.

members.name: getDouble
members.note: Same well-typed-data assumption.

members.name: getString
members.note: Reads string nodes; Java's toString fallback for a non-string tag is never reached on engine data.

members.name: getByteArray
members.note: A wrong-type key throws a ReportedException in Java and returns NULL in native; neither happens on engine data.

members.name: getIntArray
members.note: Same as getByteArray.

members.name: getCompoundTag
members.note: Java's detached empty compound for a missing key is emulated by the native callers, spelled out in crafting.c:display_compound.

members.name: getTagList
members.note: The absent-or-wrong-type empty-list case is handled by the native callers checking nbt_kind first.

members.name: getBoolean
members.note: getByte != 0.

members.name: removeTag
members.note: Removal goes through the canonical text: render, drop the member, parse back (the file's header comment describes exactly this).

members.name: toString
members.note: Canonical text form rather than Java's {key:value,...} debug format; nothing in the engine consumes Java's format.

members.name: createCrashReport
members.note: Corrupt-tag crash reporting; the native readers return NULL or an exception class name instead, and engine data is well-typed.

members.name: copy
members.note: Deep copy through the canonical text round trip.

members.name: hashCode
members.note: Only feeds the tagMap HashMap; the write order it indirectly determines is reproduced structurally from insertion order.

members.name: func_150298_a
members.note: Type byte, writeUTF name, payload; the END type writes nothing after the byte.

members.name: func_152447_a
members.note: The type-byte read at the head of the compound loop.

members.name: func_152449_a
members.note: Builds the tag by type and reads it; an IOException becomes a ReportedException in Java and a load failure in native.

members.name: NBTTagCompound$1.call
members.note: createCrashReport's tag-type section, built when getString, getByteArray, getIntArray, getCompoundTag or getTagList meets a tag of another type; the game reads every key with its written type. a crash-report section, built only while a ReportedException is being thrown; no recording crashes

members.name: NBTTagCompound$2.call
members.note: createCrashReport's expected-type section; see NBTTagCompound$1.call. a crash-report section, built only while a ReportedException is being thrown; no recording crashes

notes: The cross-type coercion in the typed getters (Java's floor for float and double read as integer kinds) is not ported because the engine only ever reads a scalar as the type it wrote, and every native tree comes from the engine's own writes, the canonical-text parse or the region reader, all well-typed. The write path is the one behind the d.ents digest; the HashMap-order emulation in nbtbin.c is what makes it byte-exact.
